disposition_reason: Forty-five glass-jar baby foods (fruit, vegetable, meat, mixed) bought in Tenerife were analysed by ICP-OES for 19 elements including cadmium, lead, aluminum and nickel; Table 5 prints means and SD per jar type on a wet-weight basis.

study.design: Retail product survey with intake and risk estimation
study.market: Supermarkets and large commercial stores in Tenerife, Canary Islands, Spain
study.method: Drying at 70 C, HNO3 then dry ashing at 450 C, ICP-OES
study.qa: SRM 1577b bovine liver, SRM 1515 apple leaves, SRM 1548a typical diet; recoveries 93.1-102.5% (Pb 98.9%, Cd 98.4%)
